result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where delivery time and fee text overlap on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25-35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text strings are overlapping and colliding with each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout container or flex/grid spacing for the restaurant metadata row so that the delivery time and delivery fee are properly separated (e.g., with a bullet separator and adequate spacing) rather than rendered on top of each other.
